contacto.descricao: Become a member of Valejas AC. Membership is €1 a month. Be part of the club's home.

inscricao.descricao: Become a member of Valejas Atlético Clube. Membership is {quota} a month. Open to everyone, and required for anyone who wants to play a sport.

hero.texto: Be part of the Valejas home. One euro a month, one application form, and you get to live the club from the inside.

quota.texto: One fee, the same for everyone. No tiers, no joining fee. You just choose how often you want to pay.
quota.inscrever: Sign me up as a Member
quota.aberto: Open to everyone. Anyone who wants to play futsal, do athletics or any other sport has to be a member first — sports registration is then handled at the clubhouse.
quota.taxa: Online payments carry a processing fee, shown before you pay.

mbway.descricao: You send the amount to the club's number using the MB WAY app.

referencia.descricao: You get an entity and reference number to pay at a Multibanco ATM or through online banking. Valid for 24 hours.

debitoDireto.descricao: The fee is taken from your account automatically. You'll never forget.

transferencia.descricao: You transfer to the club's IBAN with your name as the reference.

inscricao.texto: Membership is {quota} a month, the same for everyone. Anyone can join — and anyone who wants to play a sport at the club has to be a member first. It takes five minutes.

cta.titulo: Valejas belongs to all of us
cta.texto: Become a member for {quota} a month, wear the colours, come to the sports hall. The club belongs to those who are here.

blocos.encarregadoNota: The applicant is {idade, plural, one {# year old} other {# years old}}. By law, consent to process their data must be given by their legal guardian.
blocos.quotaNota: The club's membership fee is {quota} a month, the same for all members.

campos.emailDica: This is how the club confirms your application
campos.proponenteDica: Name of a member introducing you to the club, if any

erros.ccFormato: Invalid Citizen Card number (8 digits + digit + 2 letters + digit).
erros.rgpd: You need to authorise the processing of your data to continue.
erros.envio: We couldn't send it. Please try again.
erros.ligacao: Connection failed. Check your internet and try again.
erros.referenciaInativa: Automatic references aren't active yet. The club will email it to you.
erros.referenciaLigacao: Connection failed while generating the reference.
erros.pagamentoLigacao: Couldn't connect to the payment service.
erros.fotoTipo: It must be JPG, PNG or WEBP.

quota.pergunta: How often would you like to pay?

consentimento.maior: I authorise the processing of my data for the purpose of joining Valejas Atlético Clube as a member.
consentimento.menor: As Parent or Guardian, I authorise the processing of the data above for the purpose of joining Valejas Atlético Clube as a member.
consentimento.uso: The data is sent to the club by email and used to fill in the membership form and issue the card.
consentimento.proposta: This is an <forte>application</forte>, not an admission. The Board reviews it at a meeting and will get in touch with you. Only after that is there any payment to make.

foto.escolher: Choose file — JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 4 MB
foto.ajuda: It's for your membership card. Passport-style photo, facing the camera, light background.

dados.direcaoEnvia: (the Board will send it by email)

pagamento.soDepois: {metodo} — your form is only sent to the club after this step.
pagamento.mbwayPedido: You'll get a payment request in the MB WAY app. Confirm it there and this page will update by itself — you don't need to tell anyone.
pagamento.aguardaTexto: Open the MB WAY app and accept the request. You have 4 minutes. Don't close this page.
pagamento.expirado: The request expired without being confirmed.
pagamento.recusado: The payment was declined in the app.
pagamento.erro: There was a problem talking to the payment service.
pagamento.mbwayManual: Automatic payment isn't available right now. Send the amount through the MB WAY app to the club's number, with your name in the message.
pagamento.transferencia: Transfer to the club's IBAN and write your name in the description.
pagamento.referencia: Pay at a Multibanco ATM or through online banking with these details. The reference is valid for 24 hours.
pagamento.referenciaGuarda: Keep these details. Once you've paid, the club gets the confirmation automatically — you don't need to tell anyone.
pagamento.debitoDireto: The club will send you the direct debit mandate to sign. From then on the fee is taken from your account automatically.

concluida.pago: Payment confirmed, {nome}. You're signed up and your form has gone to the Board.
concluida.pendente: Your form has reached the Board, {nome}. We just need to confirm your fee payment so your card can be issued.
concluida.transferencia: Transfer to the club's IBAN and use your name as the description, so the Board knows who it's from.
concluida.debitoDireto: We've recorded your IBAN. The club will send you the direct debit mandate to sign — from then on the fee is taken automatically and you don't need to worry about it again.
concluida.mbway: Open the MB WAY app, send the amount to the club's number and write your name in the message.
concluida.referencia: You chose {metodo}. The club will email you the entity and reference.
concluida.depois: Once payment is confirmed, the President issues your membership number and card, which you collect at the clubhouse. If you want to sign up for a sport, make the most of the trip — sports registration is handled there.
